test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Make better
solution: The correct answer is '**Improve**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Improve**'. • It means 'to become or to make something better'. (किसी स्थिति का बेहतर होना या उसे बेहतर बनाना, सुधरना या सुधारना) • *Example: I hope the weather will **improve** later on.* **Correct Answer:__** *Improve.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words:​​ • **Increase**: to become or to make something larger in number or amount. (संख्‍या या मात्रा में वृद्धि होना या करना, संख्‍या या मात्रा की दृष्टि से बढ़ना या बढ़ाना • **Change**: to become different or to make somebody/something different. (बदलना, परिवर्तन करना • **Delete**: to remove something that is written. (लिखित अंश को हटाना) 38:T571, The correct answer is** 'Ready to do everything for someone'.**
